text:
alex_k: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: pushed kernel patch to reduce lock contention in the batcher (PR #428). Ran microbench (~50k tokens), p95 down from ~48ms to ~36ms. Blockers: seeing occasional KV cache eviction spikes on shard-3 under synthetic microburst. Suspect prefetch timing. Today: iterate on prefetch window + run larger microburst sims and open a canary.

rita: nice on the p95! can you paste the bench command you ran?

alex_k: ran `scripts/bench/microburst --shards=8 --tokens=50000 --rps=200` — snippet below:
```
p95: 48.2ms -> 36.1ms
cpu: 62% -> 58%
kv-evict-count: spike @ t=210s on shard-3
```

sam: re KV evicts — I saw similar on the eu canary yesterday, looks like our eviction threshold tightens under certain slot-steal patterns. @drew any heuristics we can adjust quickly?

drew: I can take a look later today. my hunch: cold-start grace is too short after the patch; prefetch window might be missing cross-slot dependencies. also, can you capture `kv_stats` output when it spikes? quick curl to get counters: `curl http://localhost:8100/metrics/kv`

alex_k: will grab that and post logs. small ask: can someone review PR #428? it touches batch slot allocation and I'd like a quick eyes before canary. @rita @sam?

rita: on it, sending review comments in the next hour.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for canary at 09:30 UTC. initiated by alex_k.

sam: blocker for me: need deterministic repro for shard-3 eviction so I can run it in CI. alex, can you add a tiny repro script to the PR that triggers the microburst on shard-3?

alex_k: good idea — I'll add `tests/repro/kv-evict-shard3.sh` to the PR in a few mins with exact flags.

drew: FYI I'll spin a canary in eu-west-1 at 10:00 to see if region networking affects eviction timing.

alex_k: thanks — if the eu canary is green and no evict spikes, we promote. if not, revert and follow up. I'll post the kv logs here once I have them.

rita: thanks team :thumbsup:

sam: ping me when canary results land; I'll queue the perf regression suite and the slot-steal simulator.

alex_k: done for now — updating PR with repro script and logs, will share link here when ready.
